claim_boundary: All v1.0.3 estimates are exploratory within-chooser conditional associations. The design identifies a reduced-form reference-dependent schedule, not a causal or structural price elasticity.
headline_object: reference-dependent demand schedule, not one global elasticity
operative_price_margin: signed chooser_draw_payoff_v2 relative to pre-game rating

primary_full_schedule_companion.indicator_warning: full-range functional-form component; not a clean discontinuity

primary_loss_side_scalar_companion.definition: mean-scaled LPM elasticity of kindness with respect to strictly positive reference-loss magnitude

prior_v102_opportunity_cost_elasticity.claim_boundary: functional-form-sensitive conditional association with a premium deterministically generated by rating state; not a causal price elasticity
prior_v102_opportunity_cost_elasticity.direction: positive: conditionally upward-sloping; not a causal demand curve
prior_v102_opportunity_cost_elasticity.price_unit: rating-point premium forgone by drawing instead of claiming
prior_v102_opportunity_cost_elasticity.quantity: probability of a kind draw within certified fair states
